title: Echoes
lyrics_synced:
[03:40.96] Overhead the albatross
[03:44.58] Hangs motionless upon the air
[03:48.21] And deep beneath the rolling waves
[03:52.33] In labyrinths of coral caves
[03:56.20] An echo of a distant time
[04:00.07] Comes willowing across the sand
[04:03.70] And everything is green and submarine.
[04:11.44] And no one called us to the land
[04:15.31] And no one knows the where's or why's.
[04:19.42] Something stirs and something tries
[04:23.54] Starts to climb toward the light.
[04:58.38] Strangers passing in the street
[05:02.00] By chance two separate glances meet
[05:05.63] And I am you and what I see is me.
[05:13.62] And do I take you by the hand
[05:18.21] And lead you through the land
[05:21.12] And help me understand
[05:24.02] The best I can.
[05:28.86] And no one called us to the land
[05:32.73] And no one crosses there alive.
[05:36.84] No one speaks and no one tries
[05:39.99] No one flies around the sun....
[13:29.01] Almost everyday you fall
[13:32.64] Upon my waking eyes,
[13:36.27] Inviting and inciting me
[13:40.38] To rise.
[13:44.25] And through the window in the wall
[13:48.12] Come streaming in on sunlight wings
[13:51.75] A million bright ambassadors of morning.
[13:59.49] And no one sings me lulabyes
[14:03.37] And no one makes me close my eyes
[14:07.48] So I throw the windows wide
[14:11.35] And call to you across the sky....
[17:28.04] @FeuNeuLeu
